_comment: Retrieval lab stage 2 on CORE (infra/core/lab_stage2.sh). Copy to lab_stage2.json next to compose.yml to change it. The dense model is the dense slot of the RX580 service config (container path); expect_dense_key is an assertion: the run stops if the service serves another dense encoder. To switch to J's winner, change the service's rx580.json (and restart rx580-retrieval), then this key.
